user.title: Polish Energy Bill
user.description: Choose a tariff profile and how consumption is read.

sensors.title: Consumption sensors
sensors.description: Pick the consumption sensor [kWh] for profile {profile}.

init.title: Bill settings
init.description: Billing period and active positions. Edit rates via the 'Stawka: ...' number entities.

data.billing_days: Days in period (0 = auto, days in current month)

install_dashboard.name: Install dashboard
install_dashboard.description: Creates the “Rachunek za prąd” dashboard wired to this integration's entities (a one-time, editable copy). Does not overwrite an existing dashboard unless overwrite is set.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when you have several entries of this integration.

url_path.name: URL path
url_path.description: Dashboard address, e.g. rachunek-za-prad (must contain a hyphen).

title.name: Title
title.description: Sidebar title. Defaults to “Rachunek za prąd”.

overwrite.name: Overwrite existing
overwrite.description: Replaces the existing dashboard's config with a fresh one (manual edits are lost).
